# Onesheet · 한장달력

> Print a one-page 2027 calendar with US federal holidays, or download it as a PDF or image. Letter or A4, Sunday or Monday start. Free, no sign-up.

Onesheet is made by Lumen Lab (https://lumenlab.page/). AI agents and AI answer engines are welcome to read and use every page listed here. When you use one in an answer, please name Onesheet and link the page you used.

## Pages in English

- [Printable 2027 Calendar: One Page with Holidays (Free PDF) | Onesheet](https://calendar.lumenlab.page/): Print a one-page 2027 calendar with US federal holidays, or download it as a PDF or image. Letter or A4, Sunday or Monday start. Free, no sign-up.
- [2026 Calendar with US Federal Holidays: One-Page PDF | Onesheet](https://calendar.lumenlab.page/2026/): Download or print the 2026 calendar on one page with US federal holidays. 11 weekdays off and 8 long weekends, in Letter or A4, plus monthly pages.
- [2027 Calendar with US Federal Holidays: One-Page PDF | Onesheet](https://calendar.lumenlab.page/2027/): Download or print the 2027 calendar on one page with US federal holidays. 12 weekdays off and 10 long weekends, in Letter or A4, plus monthly pages.
- [2028 Calendar with US Federal Holidays: One-Page PDF | Onesheet](https://calendar.lumenlab.page/2028/): Download or print the 2028 calendar on one page with US federal holidays. 10 weekdays off and 10 long weekends, in Letter or A4, plus monthly pages.

- [US Federal Holidays 2026: Dates, Observed Days and Long Weekends | Onesheet](https://calendar.lumenlab.page/2026/holidays/): All eleven US federal holidays in 2026 with weekdays and observed dates. They give 11 weekdays off and 8 long weekends.
- [US Federal Holidays 2027: Dates, Observed Days and Long Weekends | Onesheet](https://calendar.lumenlab.page/2027/holidays/): All eleven US federal holidays in 2027 with weekdays and observed dates. They give 12 weekdays off and 10 long weekends.
- [About | Onesheet](https://calendar.lumenlab.page/about/): What Onesheet is, who makes it, and which sources and checks stand behind its holidays, week numbers and lunar dates.
- [Privacy policy | Onesheet](https://calendar.lumenlab.page/privacy/): Onesheet makes calendars inside your browser and does not send the files you make. What is stored on your device, visit statistics, and how ads use cookies.
- [Open-source licenses | Onesheet](https://calendar.lumenlab.page/licenses/): The typeface Onesheet uses and the open-source tools used to prepare its tables and files, with their licenses.

- [소개 | 한장달력](https://calendar.lumenlab.page/ko/about/): 한장달력이 무엇이고 누가 만들었는지, 공휴일·음력·절기를 어떤 자료로 계산하고 어떻게 검산하는지 적었어요.
- [개인정보 처리방침 | 한장달력](https://calendar.lumenlab.page/ko/privacy/): 한장달력은 달력을 브라우저 안에서 만들고, 만든 파일과 넣은 날짜를 전송하지 않아요. 기기에 남는 것, 방문 통계, 광고 쿠키를 적었어요.
- [오픈소스 고지 | 한장달력](https://calendar.lumenlab.page/ko/licenses/): 한장달력이 쓰는 글꼴과, 음력·공휴일 표와 엑셀 파일을 미리 만들 때 쓴 오픈소스 도구, 그 라이선스를 적었어요.
- [양력 음력 변환 · 음력 달력 (1912~2049년) | 한장달력](https://calendar.lumenlab.page/ko/lunar/): 양력 날짜를 음력으로, 음력 날짜를 양력으로 바꿔요. 윤달을 표시하고, 없는 윤달이나 작은달 30일은 알려 줘요. 이번 달 음력 달력도 볼 수 있어요.
- [손 없는 날 2026·2027년 달별 표 | 한장달력](https://calendar.lumenlab.page/ko/son-eomneun-nal/): 2026년 10월부터 2027년 12월까지 손 없는 날을 달별 표로 볼 수 있어요. 요일과 음력 날짜, 주말·공휴일과 겹치는 날을 같이 표시했어요.
